main.content:
==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|En-au-give birth.ogg|a=AU}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|<,,gave,given>}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|of [[viviparous]] animals}} To [[release]] [[live]] [[offspring]] from the [[body]] into the [[environment]].
#: {{ux|en|It was clear that she was about to '''give birth'''.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|with ''to''|of [[viviparous]] animals}} To become the [[parent]] of by [[birthing]].
#: {{ux|en|She '''gave birth''' to a beautiful baby girl.}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1988
|author=Emily Honig; w:Gail Hershatter
|chapter=Divorce
|title=Personal Voices: Chinese Women in the 1980's
|url=https://archive.org/details/personalvoicesch00honi/
|location=[[Stanford]], Cali.
|publisher=w:Stanford University Press
|ISBN=0-8047-1431-2
|LCCN=87-18013
|OCLC=716396340
|page=219
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/personalvoicesch00honi/page/219/
|text=The case of a woman named Qu Hua from Qiqihaer, Heilongjiang, illustrates this possibility. She married a worker named Xu Baocheng in 1980, and they got along very well until she '''gave birth''' to a girl. Then Xu immediately began to beat Qu, and forced her and the baby to live in a small shack.}}
#* {{quote-web
|en
|date=June 1, 2022
|author=Collier Jennings
|title='{{w|The Orville}}': Everything You Need to Know Before Season 3
|url=https://collider.com/orville-season-3-everything-you-need-to-know-before/
|work=The Collider
|text=The rest of the ''Orville's'' crew underwent changes as well. Bortus' beliefs were challenged when he '''gave birth''' to a daughter - on Moclan society, males are the dominant species and females must undergo a mandatory sex change.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260927103728/https://collider.com/orville-season-3-everything-you-need-to-know-before/|archivedate=27 September 2026}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|figuratively|usually|with ''to''|idiom}} To become the [[source]] of.
#: {{ux|en|Einstein '''gave birth''' to a famous equation relating energy to mass.}}

====Usage notes====
* To ''give birth'' refers to either the moment of childbirth as a point in time or to the period of {{m|en|labor}} preceding childbirth.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|shit out}} {{q|vulgar}}
